title: What a logo does — Image Wiki

rules.rule: A logo identifies by matching shapes at a glance rather than explaining the business or arguing quality.
rules.evidence: That is the whole job of a logo, and it is a smaller job than most people expect. A logo identifies.

rules.rule: A logo must be reproducible in one colour and at exceedingly small sizes to survive reproduction conditions.
rules.evidence: Rand names only two requirements as mandatory — that a logo be reproducible in one colour, and at exceedingly small sizes.
